title: nan
authors: Nahangi M.; Heins A.; McCabe B.; Schoellig A.
key_contribution: Presents a UAV localization method using AprilTags and BIM for GPS-denied indoor construction environments with experimental validation against ground truth.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
